David Errigo Jr. is a voice actor for the English-language dub of . He is currently affiliated with SBV Talent Agency.

==Biography==
As an adult, Errigo became a voice actor and got minor roles in 2013 and 2014. Starting in 2015, he got more significant roles in TV shows and video games. Errigo joined the during and voiced, among others, Nihei, one of the older brothers of 's friend Sanpei. Later in , he would voice .
